title: RRB Junior Engineer JE Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Junior Engineer posts in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, S&T and other departments as per RRB JE CEN
qualification: Diploma / Degree in Engineering in relevant branch as per post
ageLimit: 18 to 33 years typically (as per JE CEN; relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → Document Verification → Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open RRB JE CEN Apply Online
3. Create account and select posts/zones
4. Upload photo, sign, certificates and pay fee
5. Submit application before last date
shortDescription: RRB Junior Engineer JE Online Form 2026 – apply for technical JE posts across Railway zones at rrbapply.gov.in.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards conduct the Junior Engineer (JE) examination for various technical departments of Indian Railways.

Diploma/Degree holders in relevant engineering branches can apply online at rrbapply.gov.in. Selection includes multi-stage CBT, document verification and medical exam.
